Class ButtonInput<TButton>

Namespace: osu.Framework.Input.StateChanges
Assembly: osu.Framework.dll

An abstract base class of an osu.Framework.Input.StateChanges.IInput which denotes a list of button state changes (pressed or released).

public abstract class ButtonInput<TButton> : IInput where TButton : struct

protected ButtonInput(ButtonStates<TButton>? current, ButtonStates<TButton>? previous)

current ButtonStates<TButton>?

The newer osu.Framework.Input.States.ButtonStates`1.

previous ButtonStates<TButton>?

The older osu.Framework.Input.States.ButtonStates`1.

Remarks

Buttons that are pressed in previous and not pressed in current will be listed as osu.Framework.Input.StateChanges.ButtonStateChangeKind.Released. Buttons that are not pressed in previous and pressed in current will be listed as osu.Framework.Input.StateChanges.ButtonStateChangeKind.Pressed.
